# Third-party dependencies

| Path | Source | Install |
|------|--------|---------|
| `ktc/` | [timed-c/ktc](https://github.com/timed-c/ktc) | `bash scripts/timedc/install_ktc_rpi5__安装KTC.sh` |

The KTC tree is not vendored in git. Pi/aarch64 patches live in `scripts/timedc/ktc_overlay/` and are applied after clone.
